stop.command: script="$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/handoff/hooks/cursor-checkpoint.js"; for d in "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin "$HOME/.fnm/node-versions"/*/installation/bin "$HOME/.asdf/installs/nodejs"/*/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do [ -x "$d/node" ] && exec "$d/node" "$script"; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec node "$script"; exit 0
